request.recipient: 2026 Treasury Reserve Smart Contract stake address stake1784sdxt6jjennmstphgdu7l7c2scf5d02a6cve2dgn5s2kq5u3j9v, administered by Intersect for the Wirex project
request.what: Fund Bringing Real-World Payments to Cardano with Wirex, including open-source payments infrastructure, onchain settlement, Visa card issuance linked to onchain balances, stablecoin-backed banking rails, wallet/API integration, oversight, and administration through Intersect-managed treasury smart contracts.

claims.claim: The proposal requests 3,961,538 ADA, consisting of 3,846,153 ADA for WP1 Enabling Onchain Payments & Card Infrastructure and 115,385 ADA for an Intersect Budget Administration fee.
Wirex will deliver full-stack open-source payments infrastructure enabling onchain settlement through smart contracts and connectivity to banking rails, stablecoin systems, and wallet interfaces.
The proposal says a core outcome is Visa card issuance linked directly to onchain balances, allowing users to spend digital assets globally at millions of merchants.
Wirex is described as having 7 million users, more than 1.5 million cards issued, more than $20 billion in transaction volume, and experience as a Visa Principal Member.

The proposal achieved the required 67% support threshold during the 2026 Intersect Budget Process Hydra Voting phase and was advanced for on-chain Treasury Withdrawal submission under the approved Budget Process Framework.
The proposal asserts that the requested withdrawal does not, alone or in aggregate at submission time, breach the applicable 350M ADA Net Change Limit covering Epoch 613 to Epoch 713.
Wirex has not received ADA from the Cardano Treasury within the last 24 months.

Treasury funds will be administered through a 2026 Treasury Reserve Smart Contract and one Project-Specific Smart Contract, with specified stake/payment addresses and a public dashboard for auditability.
The Oversight Committee is stated to include Sundae Labs, Cardano Foundation, Dquadrant, NMKR, Sundial, and Eternl, with multi-party authorization requirements for TRSC and PSSC actions.
Independent oversight is said to be provided through Intersect and technically capable third parties, including reporting obligations and milestone-based disbursement controls.

summary: The document requests 3,961,538 ADA for a Wirex real-world payments project submitted by Intersect, with claims centered on open-source payment infrastructure, Visa card-linked spending, Wirex adoption credentials, Intersect budget-process approval, NCL compliance, and smart-contract-based treasury administration.
